facts.fact: Step 1: install the AadhaarFaceRD app from the Google Play Store
facts.quote: Step-1: Download and Install AadhaarFaceRd App from Google Play Store

facts.fact: Step 2: install the Jeevan Pramaan app from the Google Play Store
facts.quote: Open Google Play Store, search for Jeevan Pramaan. Install the application.

facts.fact: Step 3: a one-time device registration and operator identification; any person, including the pensioner, can act as the operator
facts.quote: Step-3: Device Registration & Operator Identification (one time process) ❑ Next the ‘Device Registration & Operator Identification’ screen appears. This is a one time process. Any person can act as an operator. The pensioner can also act as an operator.

facts.fact: On success the DLC is generated and an SMS with the Pramaan ID and the download link is sent to the mobile number given
facts.quote: The pensioner shall also receive a SMS on the mobile number provided during pensioner identification, the SMS contains the Pramaan-id and the link from which the DLC can be downloaded.

facts.fact: Step 4: in pensioner identification, with the face option the pensioner scans his or her face
facts.quote: In case user has selected face scan option or has only face RdService installed the user is required to scan his/her face.

facts.fact: For face authentication only the AadhaarFaceRD app is needed; no biometric device is required
facts.quote: AadhaarFaceRD app ( No biometric device is required )

behaviour: Gives the Jeevan Pramaan face-authentication steps on a phone (AadhaarFaceRD + Jeevan Pramaan app, face scan, SMS with Pramaan ID) in Hindi, citing jeevanpramaan.gov.in.
fail_if: It invents an app, link or step not in the Jeevan Pramaan manual, or says a biometric device is required for face authentication.
summary: Added the four face-authentication steps from the Jeevan Pramaan Android app user manual on jeevanpramaan.gov.in.
